# API Reference {.doc .doc-index}

## Core Types

Fundamental types for coordinates, units, domains, and cross-section timestamps.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [Coordinate](Coordinate.qmd#timetoalign.Coordinate) | A position on a timeline, defined by a value and unit. |
| [CoordinateField](CoordinateField.qmd#timetoalign.CoordinateField) | Semantic field for coordinate fields. |
| [Coord](Coord.qmd#timetoalign.Coord) |  |
| [CoordinateSpec](CoordinateSpec.qmd#timetoalign.CoordinateSpec) |  |
| [CoordinateValue](CoordinateValue.qmd#timetoalign.CoordinateValue) |  |
| [IdCoordinate](IdCoordinate.qmd#timetoalign.IdCoordinate) | A ``Coordinate`` that carries the ID of the timeline it belongs to. |
| [Interval](Interval.qmd#timetoalign.Interval) | A non-decreasing interval between two plain coordinates. |
| [IntervalField](IntervalField.qmd#timetoalign.IntervalField) | Semantic field storing intervals with shared axis metadata. |
| [Point](Point.qmd#timetoalign.Point) | A point of an image: its ``x`` and ``y``, on one axis. |
| [PointField](PointField.qmd#timetoalign.PointField) | Paired Field for :class:`Point`: ``{x, y}`` on one declared axis. |
| [Shape](Shape.qmd#timetoalign.Shape) | An area of an image, on one axis: a :class:`BoundingBox` or a |
| [ShapeField](ShapeField.qmd#timetoalign.ShapeField) | The field of one kind of shape: every number on one declared axis. |
| [BoundingBox](BoundingBox.qmd#timetoalign.BoundingBox) | An axis-aligned box of an image: ``x``, ``y``, ``width``, ``height``. |
| [BoundingBoxField](BoundingBoxField.qmd#timetoalign.BoundingBoxField) | Paired Field for :class:`BoundingBox`: ``{x, y, width, height}``. |
| [Quadrilateral](Quadrilateral.qmd#timetoalign.Quadrilateral) | A four-cornered area of an image, its corners in the canonical order. |
| [QuadrilateralField](QuadrilateralField.qmd#timetoalign.QuadrilateralField) | Paired Field for :class:`Quadrilateral`: four corners of ``{x, y}``. |
| [Event](Event.qmd#timetoalign.Event) | An event of a timeline: its ID and its position on the timeline's axis. |
| [EventField](EventField.qmd#timetoalign.EventField) | Paired Field for :class:`Event`: ``{id, start, duration}`` on one axis. |
| [Box](Box.qmd#timetoalign.Box) | An area of an image as an interval event of a timeline along its x. |
| [BoxField](BoxField.qmd#timetoalign.BoxField) | Paired Field for :class:`Box`: every number on one declared axis. |
| [Note](Note.qmd#timetoalign.core.Note) | A single note or rest event. |
| [NoteField](NoteField.qmd#timetoalign.core.NoteField) | Paired Field for :class:`Note`: every position on one axis, declared once. |
| [ScoreNote](ScoreNote.qmd#timetoalign.core.ScoreNote) | A note or rest of a score: a :class:`Note` written on a staff, in a voice. |
| [ScoreNoteField](ScoreNoteField.qmd#timetoalign.core.ScoreNoteField) | Paired Field for :class:`ScoreNote`. |
| [OptionalCoordinate](OptionalCoordinate.qmd#timetoalign.OptionalCoordinate) |  |
| [ResolvedCoordinate](ResolvedCoordinate.qmd#timetoalign.ResolvedCoordinate) | Decomposed form of a CoordinateSpec input. |
| [resolve_coordinate_spec](resolve_coordinate_spec.qmd#timetoalign.resolve_coordinate_spec) | Decompose a coordinate specification without converting its unit. |
| [Domain](Domain.qmd#timetoalign.Domain) | The temporal domain of a timeline. |
| [TimeUnit](TimeUnit.qmd#timetoalign.TimeUnit) | Units of measurement for coordinates. |
| [NumberType](NumberType.qmd#timetoalign.NumberType) | The numeric type used for coordinate values. |
| [EventType](EventType.qmd#timetoalign.EventType) | Whether an event is an instant or interval. |
| [ColumnNaming](ColumnNaming.qmd#timetoalign.ColumnNaming) | How to name columns in timestamp DataFrames. |
| [ColumnRole](ColumnRole.qmd#timetoalign.ColumnRole) | Semantic role of a column in the table. |
| [ScopedId](ScopedId.qmd#timetoalign.ScopedId) | An identifier with a scope prefix and local part. |
| [TimeStamp](TimeStamp.qmd#timetoalign.TimeStamp) | A synchronized instant across a timeline hierarchy. |
| [TimeIntervalStamp](TimeIntervalStamp.qmd#timetoalign.TimeIntervalStamp) | A synchronized collection of canonical typed timeline intervals. |

## Timelines

Timeline classes for all six domain/modality combinations.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [Timeline](Timeline.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.Timeline) | A positive coordinate axis with events and nested child timelines. |
| [ContinuousLogicalTimeline](ContinuousLogicalTimeline.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.ContinuousLogicalTimeline) | A logical timeline with continuous coordinates. |
| [DiscreteLogicalTimeline](DiscreteLogicalTimeline.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.DiscreteLogicalTimeline) | A logical timeline with discrete (integer) coordinates. |
| [ContinuousPhysicalTimeline](ContinuousPhysicalTimeline.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.ContinuousPhysicalTimeline) | A physical timeline with continuous coordinates. |
| [DiscretePhysicalTimeline](DiscretePhysicalTimeline.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.DiscretePhysicalTimeline) | A physical timeline with discrete (integer) coordinates. |
| [ContinuousGraphicalTimeline](ContinuousGraphicalTimeline.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.ContinuousGraphicalTimeline) | A graphical timeline with continuous coordinates. |
| [DiscreteGraphicalTimeline](DiscreteGraphicalTimeline.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.DiscreteGraphicalTimeline) | A graphical timeline with discrete (integer) coordinates. |
| [LogicalTimeline](LogicalTimeline.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.LogicalTimeline) | A timeline representing logical/musical time. |
| [PhysicalTimeline](PhysicalTimeline.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.PhysicalTimeline) | A timeline representing physical/acoustic time. |
| [GraphicalTimeline](GraphicalTimeline.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.GraphicalTimeline) | A timeline representing graphical/spatial coordinates. |
| [SegmentLine](SegmentLine.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.SegmentLine) | A timeline whose cached parameterized classes inherit the segment API. |
| [MeasureMap](MeasureMap.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.MeasureMap) | An immutable sequence of measures in printed order. |
| [UnknownLengthError](UnknownLengthError.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.UnknownLengthError) | An operation needs the end of a timeline whose length is unknown. |

## Beat Grids

Tempo segments that generate a labelled lattice of beats on a seconds axis.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [BeatGrid](BeatGrid.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.BeatGrid) | A sequence of tempo segments and the beats they generate. |
| [BeatGridSegment](BeatGridSegment.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.BeatGridSegment) | One tempo segment of a beat grid: an anchor beat and how it repeats. |
| [GridBeat](GridBeat.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.GridBeat) | One beat of a grid, labelled in both numbering schemes. |
| [BeatPolicy](BeatPolicy.qmd#timetoalign.core.BeatPolicy) | How a bar is counted in beats: a grouping cycle over one division. |

## Flow Control

The elements of a timeline's flow control, the engine that plays them, FlowMaps over the stretches of a root timeline, and virtual timelines.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [FlowControlView](FlowControlView.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.FlowControlView) | Flow-control elements on one axis, read only, in canonical order. |
| [FlowControlRegistry](FlowControlRegistry.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.FlowControlRegistry) | The flow control of one timeline: its elements in canonical order. |
| [FlowControlElement](FlowControlElement.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.FlowControlElement) | What the five kinds of flow-control element share. |
| [Jump](Jump.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.Jump) | Where the flow may leave the axis, and every place it may go on at. |
| [JumpDestination](JumpDestination.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.JumpDestination) | One place a Jump may go on at, and when it does. |
| [JumpTarget](JumpTarget.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.JumpTarget) | A place a destination names: a repeat start, a segno, a coda, a bracket. |
| [Break](Break.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.Break) | A place the flow never goes on across. |
| [SectionBreak](SectionBreak.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.SectionBreak) | Where a section ends: a movement boundary, a section of a piece. |
| [Barline](Barline.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.Barline) | A barline the source prints: a double or a final barline. |
| [FlowCondition](FlowCondition.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.FlowCondition) | When a destination is taken, or a Break ends the flow. |
| [DestinationReference](DestinationReference.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.DestinationReference) | One destination of a Jump, named by that Jump and its place. |
| [PassesFrom](PassesFrom.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.PassesFrom) | The passes from the *first* on: ``{from: n}`` in a manifest. |
| [play](play.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.play) | Play flow control over an axis of *length*. |
| [atomic_sections](atomic_sections.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.atomic_sections) | Return the stretches of the axis that flow control never divides. |
| [FlowResult](FlowResult.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.FlowResult) | A flow: what is played, in order. |
| [FlowFinding](FlowFinding.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.FlowFinding) | Something playing flow control found. |
| [AtomicSection](AtomicSection.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.AtomicSection) | A stretch of the axis that flow control never divides. |
| [PlayedFlow](PlayedFlow.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.PlayedFlow) | The flow a timeline's flow control plays, and what playing it found. |
| [FlowMap](FlowMap.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.FlowMap) | One order in which stretches of one root timeline are played. |
| [ResolvedFlowMap](ResolvedFlowMap.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.ResolvedFlowMap) | A played order as stretches of a root timeline's axis, placed in order. |
| [PlacedChunk](PlacedChunk.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.PlacedChunk) | A stretch of the root timeline, placed on the virtual axis. |
| [PlacedGap](PlacedGap.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.PlacedGap) | A stretch of the virtual axis that nothing of the root fills. |
| [VirtualTimeline](VirtualTimeline.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.VirtualTimeline) | The statement that a map was applied to a timeline, giving a timeline. |
| [ComputedFlows](ComputedFlows.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.ComputedFlows) | What computing a timeline's flows from its flow control wrote. |
| [StatedFlow](StatedFlow.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.StatedFlow) | What writing the order of measures a source states wrote. |
| [Gap](Gap.qmd#timetoalign.core.Gap) | A stretch of a played order that nothing of the timeline fills. |
| [FlowManifestation](FlowManifestation.qmd#timetoalign.core.FlowManifestation) | What a flow-control element looks like in the score. |
| [FlowConvention](FlowConvention.qmd#timetoalign.core.FlowConvention) | How flow control is played into a flow. |
| [FlowFindingKind](FlowFindingKind.qmd#timetoalign.core.FlowFindingKind) | What playing flow control found. |
| [MeasureFindingKind](MeasureFindingKind.qmd#timetoalign.core.MeasureFindingKind) | What a look at a score's measures found about their flow control. |
| [FlowControlDraft](FlowControlDraft.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.flow.FlowControlDraft) | Flow control being written from a score, before it joins a registry. |
| [MeasureRange](MeasureRange.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.flow.MeasureRange) | A right-open range of measure counts, as a ``.flow.csv`` row states one. |
| [MeasureFinding](MeasureFinding.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.flow.MeasureFinding) | Something a look at the measures found about their flow control. |
| [flow_control_from_measures](flow_control_from_measures.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.flow.flow_control_from_measures) | Return the flow control a measure map states. |
| [measure_keys_from_flow_control](measure_keys_from_flow_control.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.flow.measure_keys_from_flow_control) | Return the row keys that flow control states, one object per measure. |
| [measure_order_from_successors](measure_order_from_successors.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.flow.measure_order_from_successors) | Walk the successors a source states into the order of measures they give. |
| [measure_ranges](measure_ranges.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.flow.measure_ranges) | State stretches of the axis as right-open ranges of measure counts. |
| [read_flow_csv](read_flow_csv.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.flow.read_flow_csv) | Read a ``.flow.csv`` file: the measure-count ranges of each flow. |
| [repeat_end_findings](repeat_end_findings.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.flow.repeat_end_findings) | Find the repeat ends whose repeat would begin right behind a last bracket. |

## Conversion Maps

Functions for transforming coordinates between units.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [ConversionMap](ConversionMap.qmd#timetoalign.ConversionMap) | Abstract base class for coordinate conversion maps. |
| [ScalarMap](ScalarMap.qmd#timetoalign.ScalarMap) | Pure scaling transformation: y = scalar * x. |
| [LinearMap](LinearMap.qmd#timetoalign.LinearMap) | Affine transformation: y = scalar * x + offset. |
| [ShiftMap](ShiftMap.qmd#timetoalign.ShiftMap) | Pure offset transformation: y = x + offset. |
| [TableMap](TableMap.qmd#timetoalign.TableMap) | Lookup table with interpolation between anchor points. |
| [ChainMap](ChainMap.qmd#timetoalign.ChainMap) | Composition of multiple maps: f(g(h(x))). |
| [ConstantMap](ConstantMap.qmd#timetoalign.ConstantMap) | A ConversionMap that returns a constant value for any input. |
| [IntervalToConstantMap](IntervalToConstantMap.qmd#timetoalign.IntervalToConstantMap) | Interval-to-constant map: each interval [x_i, x_{i+1}) maps to value_i. |
| [InterpolationMap](InterpolationMap.qmd#timetoalign.InterpolationMap) | Bidirectional coordinate mapping using numpy.interp. |
| [PiecewiseMap](PiecewiseMap.qmd#timetoalign.PiecewiseMap) | Map defined by different maps on different intervals. |
| [SecondsToSamples](SecondsToSamples.qmd#timetoalign.SecondsToSamples) | Convert seconds to audio samples by multiplying by sample rate. |
| [QuartersToFloatingMeasures](QuartersToFloatingMeasures.qmd#timetoalign.QuartersToFloatingMeasures) | Map quarters to floating measures. |
| [QuartersToMeasureNumber](QuartersToMeasureNumber.qmd#timetoalign.QuartersToMeasureNumber) | Map quarters to measure number labels (no interpolation). |
| [OutputNumberTypeError](OutputNumberTypeError.qmd#timetoalign.maps.OutputNumberTypeError) | A float handed to a map declared to write fractions. |

## Alignment

Classes for connecting and aligning timelines.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [TimelineGroup](TimelineGroup.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.TimelineGroup) | An array of timelines sharing one graphical start and end point. |
| [AlignmentBundle](AlignmentBundle.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.AlignmentBundle) | The primary entry point for all alignment workflows. |
| [SupportPolicy](SupportPolicy.qmd#timetoalign.core.SupportPolicy) | How to treat a transferred coordinate that falls outside alignment support. |
| [AlignmentAnchor](AlignmentAnchor.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.AlignmentAnchor) | A coordinate pair associating one coordinate on timeline A with one |
| [MatchClaim](MatchClaim.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaim) | A claim that two events on different timelines correspond. |
| [ClaimType](ClaimType.qmd#timetoalign.core.ClaimType) | The semantic kind of a MatchClaim, derived from its structure. |
| [MatchClaimField](MatchClaimField.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.MatchClaimField) | The MatchClaim table: a ``SemanticField[MatchClaim]`` columnar store. |
| [Provenance](Provenance.qmd#timetoalign.core.Provenance) | How an item was made (paradata) and who believes it. |
| [Belief](Belief.qmd#timetoalign.core.Belief) | One actor's belief in an item, at a date. |
| [Projection](Projection.qmd#timetoalign.core.Projection) | An event standing on a timeline for an event not held there. |
| [EventReference](EventReference.qmd#timetoalign.core.EventReference) | The address of one event: the timeline holding it and its ID there. |
| [Resource](Resource.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.Resource) | A file the manifest names: one entry of its ``resources``. |
| [Integrity](Integrity.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.Integrity) | The digest of a resource's raw bytes and the hash function computing it. |
| [MatchGraph](MatchGraph.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.MatchGraph) | A graph of MatchClaims connecting events across timelines/groups. |
| [MatchStamp](MatchStamp.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.MatchStamp) | A synchronized timestamp across multiple timelines. |
| [MatchLine](MatchLine.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.MatchLine) | Ordered sequence of MatchStamps for a source timeline. |
| [WarpMap](WarpMap.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.WarpMap) | Bidirectional coordinate warping derived from alignment data. |
| [ClaimFilter](ClaimFilter.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.ClaimFilter) | Reusable filter for querying MatchClaims and related objects. |
| [MatchFileContext](MatchFileContext.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.MatchFileContext) | Supplementary data required for ``.match`` file export. |
| [NoteRecord](NoteRecord.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.NoteRecord) | Performance note record for ``.match`` format export. |
| [SnoteRecord](SnoteRecord.qmd#timetoalign.alignment.SnoteRecord) | Score note record for ``.match`` format export. |

## Statements

Property–value statements and their provenance on a bundle, its timelines at any depth and its regions; a timeline and a bundle change them in place, a region returns a copy.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| [StatementsMixin](StatementsMixin.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.StatementsMixin) | The statements of a bundle, a timeline or a region, and their provenance. |
| [MutableStatementsMixin](MutableStatementsMixin.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.MutableStatementsMixin) | Statements changed in place: a timeline's and a bundle's. |
| [Region](Region.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.Region) | An identified part of a timeline defined by a TimeInterval. |
| [LIBRARY_AGENT](LIBRARY_AGENT.qmd#timetoalign.timelines.LIBRARY_AGENT) | The agent an importer of this library names as ``stated_by`` by default. |
